_comment: obs-jobs.json - the DECLARED job registry for this host.
This file is the source of truth for the obs_job table. obs-seed-jobs.js
applies it at API startup (upsert by jobName; nothing is ever deleted).
Before it existed the registry was 22 rows typed at a mysql prompt, which
meant a new collector could only be declared by someone who knew to do that
- and an undeclared job is invisible to every count on the observability
page. Add the job here and restart the API; that is the whole procedure.
scheduled is a DECLARATION, checked by hand against crontab and systemd on
the date in scheduleSrc. The API runs as `corpit` and cannot read root's
crontab, so nothing here measures it. What IS measured is whether runs
arrive, and whether they arrived ON THIS HOST (srv_job_run.host).
cadenceMin is how often it is supposed to run; graceMin is how late it may
be before it counts as overdue.

jobs.label: Observability retention prune
jobs.notes: Deletes obs_request/obs_dependency/obs_client_event past obs.retention_days and srv_job_run past obs.job_run_retention_days. Nothing pruned these tables before 2026-09-07; obs_dependency is not sampled and grows fastest. obs_client_event is aged on received_at (this server's clock), never occurred_at (the browser's), so a client with a skewed clock cannot keep its rows forever.

jobs.label: Hub API recorder heartbeat
jobs.notes: Proves the Hub API's recorder is alive by writing a run row. Its ABSENCE is the signal - a dead recorder cannot report that it is dead, so the resolver reads the missing row as overdue. It stops on purpose when obs.enabled is off, because a beat that continued would report a recorder that is recording nothing.

jobs.label: Core API recorder heartbeat
jobs.notes: The reason this exists. /api/observe/self is served BY the Hub API and can only ever answer for the Hub API, so a failed obs startup on :3000 left only a line on that process's stdout and every dashboard looked identical to a healthy one. This row is the core API's only visible sign of life. Same on-purpose stop when obs.enabled is off.

jobs.label: Gate API recorder heartbeat
jobs.notes: Proves the auth gate's recorder (corpit-gate-api on 127.0.0.1:3002, CHG-ARCH-21) is alive by writing a run row. Its ABSENCE is the signal, read as overdue, the same as the Hub API and core API beats. Same on-purpose stop when obs.enabled is off.
